body:
Greptile Summary

This PR aligns task-filter lookup with executor wildcard routing and allows matching DXO filters to process empty leaf objects. - Adds exact-first, insertion-ordered wildcard selection for task filter chains. - Moves empty-data handling into data-dependent filters while allowing kind-based and initialization filters to run. - Documents the contracts and adds focused regression coverage.

Confidence Score: 5/5

The PR appears safe to merge. No blocking failure remains.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | nvflare/apis/utils/task_utils.py | Adds exact-first wildcard task-filter lookup using the same first-matching-pattern behavior as executor routing. | | nvflare/apis/dxo_filter.py | Allows matching empty leaf DXOs to reach process_dxo while preserving replacement and filter-history behavior. | | nvflare/app_common/filters/convert_weights.py | Explicitly skips conversion when the DXO has no data. | | nvflare/app_common/filters/exclude_vars.py | Explicitly skips variable exclusion for empty DXO data. | | nvflare/app_common/filters/percentile_privacy.py | Preserves safe no-op behavior for empty privacy-filter input. | | nvflare/app_common/filters/statistics_privacy_filter.py | Avoids invoking statistics cleansers when the DXO data is empty. | | nvflare/app_common/filters/svt_privacy.py | Preserves safe no-op behavior for empty sparse-vector privacy input. | | nvflare/app_opt/he/model_encryptor.py | Skips encryption and context loading for empty model data. | | nvflare/app_opt/he/model_decryptor.py | Skips decryption and context loading for empty model data. | | nvflare/app_opt/pt/quantization/quantizer.py | Explicitly returns without quantizing empty model data. | | nvflare/app_opt/pt/quantization/dequantizer.py | Explicitly returns without dequantizing empty model data. | | tests/unit_test/apis/dxo_filter_test.py | Covers in-place and replacement initialization of empty matching DXOs. | | tests/unit_test/apis/utils/task_utils_test.py | Covers wildcard matching, exact precedence, insertion order, direction isolation, and optional filters. | | tests/unit_test/app_common/filters/empty_data_test.py | Verifies data-dependent filters skip empty input while kind-based blocking still runs. |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[Task message] --> B{Exact task filter configured?} B -->|Yes| C[Use exact filter chain] B -->|No| D{First wildcard pattern matches?} D -->|Yes| E[Use matching wildcard chain] D -->|No| F[Pass through without task filter] C --> G[Decode Shareable to DXO] E --> G F --> H[Continue message processing] G --> I{Matching leaf data kind?} I -->|No| H I -->|Yes, including empty data| J[Invoke process_dxo] J --> K{Filter returns DXO?} K -->|Yes| L[Update DXO and filter history] K -->|No| H L --> H ``` Reviews (2): Last reviewed commit: ["Merge branch 'main' into feat/filter-wil..."](https://github.com/nvidia/nvflare/commit/abcd99ac40d2204edcad868cc5a80507e77d5151) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=51354892)
